# ANALYSIS: V14E_ENHANCED_BASELINE_J_ANCHOR_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to measure the performance of the v14e_enhanced baseline on the J anchor days (both winners and losers) using a Stage-1 backtest with walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) and real-fills simulation. This will provide the edge_capture and Sharpe ratio for the baseline, which can be used as a reference for evaluating future candidates.

## Mechanism

We will run a backtest of the v14e_enhanced strategy (as defined in the codebase at the time of v14e_enhanced) over the available historical data, using a walk-forward OOS approach to avoid overfitting. We will use real OPRA fills simulation to ensure realistic P&L. We will then compute the edge_capture and Sharpe ratio specifically on the J anchor days (the 6 days listed in OP-16).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The analysis will be run assuming the standard account size for the v14e_enhanced strategy (as per params.json at the time). For the purpose of OP-16, we are measuring the engine's P&L on the anchor days in absolute dollars, so account size does not affect the edge_capture calculation (which is in dollars). However, note that the real-fills simulation must account for the minimum contract size and slippage.
2. **Sample bias:** The J anchor days are a fixed set of 6 days (source of truth). There is no selection bias in the anchor days themselves. However, the walk-forward OOS window must be chosen carefully to avoid look-ahead bias. We will use a walk-forward window that ends before the anchor days for the OOS test, or we will use the entire history with walk-forward and then extract the anchor days' performance from the OOS periods.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we will perform a walk-forward OOS backtest and report the OOS performance on the anchor days if they fall in the OOS window, or we will report the performance from the OOS runs that cover the anchor days).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we will use the real OPRA fills simulator for the backtest).
5. **Failure modes:** The backtest may fail to run due to missing data or code changes. We will ensure the v14e_enhanced code is available and the data is present.
6. **Concentration:** We will report the concentration of P&L on the anchor days relative to the total OOS P&L.
